conventions: Capacity is gross capacity (Bruttoleistung) in kW unless the field name says mw, gw, mwh or gwh.
Dates are ISO (YYYY-MM-DD), months YYYY-MM, all in German local dates as registered; time series from APIs are UTC.
Germany only, except auctions/players.json and the worldwide parts of auctions/company_facts.json.
Every file carries or inherits the as_of date of manifest.json; recent months are incomplete because units are registered weeks late (manifest.incomplete_after gives the date per technology).
Units of natural persons have no name, operator or coordinates; small units appear only in totals (summary.parquet).
Operator and bidder names only for legal entities; operator names only for units of 1 MW or more.
Company groups come from name rules, office addresses and hand-checked assignments; 'Not attributed' means the owner is unknown.
